bodyMapGroups.label: Chest
bodyMapGroups.note: Pectoral anatomy; head-level exposure remains distinct from the whole muscle.

subregions.label: Pectoralis major
limitations: Abdominal part remains part of the parent muscle view; BodyCast has no separate abdominal-part node.

subregions.label: Clavicular head of pectoralis major
limitations: Source calls this the clavicular part; separate exercise head exposure is not inferred.

subregions.label: Sternocostal head of pectoralis major
limitations: Source calls this the sternocostal part; separate exercise head exposure is not inferred.

bodyMapGroups.label: Deltoids
bodyMapGroups.note: Anterior, acromial and posterior deltoid regions.

subregions.label: Anterior deltoid
limitations: BodyCast anterior region maps to the source clavicular part.

subregions.label: Middle (acromial) deltoid
limitations: BodyCast middle region maps to the source acromial part.

subregions.label: Posterior deltoid
limitations: BodyCast posterior region maps to the source spinal part.

bodyMapGroups.label: Triceps
bodyMapGroups.note: Triceps brachii and source-supported heads.

bodyMapGroups.label: Back
bodyMapGroups.note: Upper-back anatomy; spinal extensors stay in their own group.

subregions.label: Latissimus dorsi
limitations: BodyCast-authored educational approximation (bodycast-authored-muscle-volumes-v2.0.0): Closed, body-conformed posterior fan volume with a rounded perimeter; independently authored.

subregions.label: Upper trapezius
limitations: Descending fibers form the upper trapezius region.

subregions.label: Middle trapezius
limitations: Transverse fibers form the middle trapezius region.

subregions.label: Lower trapezius
limitations: Ascending fibers form the lower trapezius region.

bodyMapGroups.label: Elbow flexors
bodyMapGroups.note: Legacy exercise analytics group; not a claim that every member is a biceps head.

bodyMapGroups.label: Forearms
bodyMapGroups.note: Forearm regions and brachioradialis.

subregions.label: Forearm flexor region
limitations: Official anterior forearm compartment, including its available superficial and deep FJ pieces.

subregions.label: Forearm extensor region
limitations: Official posterior forearm compartment; brachioradialis is mapped separately.

bodyMapGroups.label: Spinal extensors
bodyMapGroups.note: Erector-spinae regions, separate from the upper-back crosswalk.

subregions.label: Lumbar erector spinae region
limitations: Iliocostalis lumborum only; no wider unsupported lumbar boundary is inferred.

subregions.label: Thoracic erector spinae region
limitations: Thoracic iliocostalis, longissimus and spinalis source concepts.

bodyMapGroups.label: Hip extensors
bodyMapGroups.note: Legacy functional analytics grouping. It intentionally overlaps gluteal and hamstring views.

bodyMapGroups.label: Abdominal wall
bodyMapGroups.note: Rectus, oblique and transversus abdominis structures.

subregions.label: Rectus abdominis
limitations: BodyCast-authored educational approximation (bodycast-authored-muscle-volumes-v2.0.0): Paired closed belly volumes with a linea alba gap and shallow tendinous intersections; independently authored.

subregions.label: Internal abdominal oblique
limitations: BodyCast-authored educational approximation (bodycast-authored-muscle-volumes-v2.0.0): Paired rounded flank muscle volumes, deep to external oblique, with superomedial fiber direction; independently authored.

subregions.label: Transversus abdominis
limitations: BodyCast-authored educational approximation (bodycast-authored-muscle-volumes-v2.0.0): Paired rounded deep flank muscle volumes with transverse fiber direction; independently authored.

bodyMapGroups.label: Quadriceps
bodyMapGroups.note: Rectus femoris and three vasti.

bodyMapGroups.label: Hamstrings
bodyMapGroups.note: Posterior-thigh muscles; the short head of biceps femoris is shown as a knee-flexor structure.

bodyMapGroups.label: Gluteals
bodyMapGroups.note: Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus.

bodyMapGroups.label: Hip adductors
bodyMapGroups.note: Source-supported medial-thigh adductors.

bodyMapGroups.label: Hip abductors
bodyMapGroups.note: Gluteus medius/minimus and tensor fasciae latae; overlapping memberships are intentional.

bodyMapGroups.label: Hip flexors
bodyMapGroups.note: Iliacus and psoas major as distinct source structures.

bodyMapGroups.label: Calves
bodyMapGroups.note: Medial/lateral gastrocnemius and soleus.

bodyMapGroups.label: Anterior lower leg
bodyMapGroups.note: Tibialis anterior and extensor digitorum longus.

bodyMapGroups.label: Lateral lower leg
bodyMapGroups.note: Fibularis longus and brevis.

bodyMapGroups.label: Rotator cuff
bodyMapGroups.note: Supraspinatus, infraspinatus, teres minor and subscapularis; deep surfaces can be occluded in overview.

bodyMapGroups.label: Serratus anterior
bodyMapGroups.note: Bilateral source muscle; do not infer numeric exercise stimulus.

Older per-OBJ headers are preserved and documented; this branch follows the current official database terms without treating separate written permission as an automatic prerequisite.
